results.content:
Gender: Roughly two-thirds of women (70%) disapprove of Trump's performance. Men lean unfavorable toward Trump, with 60% disapproving and 35% approving.

Age: Roughly two-thirds of voters aged 18-34 (74%) disapprove of Trump's performance, followed by 70% of 35-49-year-olds, 59% of 50-64-year-olds and 58% of those 65 and older. [...] Party: Democrats were most unfavorable toward Trump, with 98% disapproving, followed by independents at 62% disapproval. Meanwhile, Republicans were the most favorable toward Trump, with 82% approving of Trump's job performance.

Race: Black or African-American voters had the highest unfavorable opinion of Trump, with 88% disapproving, followed by Hispanic/Latin
results.title: A new low for Trump approval rating triggered by ongoing war with Iran
